The new diagnostic executes the complete closing-stream method with real RxJS option-change scheduling and controlled visibility/render boundaries. It reproduces the pre-fix empty-to-visible recapture and also exercises hide/show; actual Angular option filtering and outside dismissal remain required.

The removed helper is private. Current owned and both minimum source implementations use an inline capture, with no call to this helper. Do not restore obsolete private machinery or mirror a modern public component API merely to reproduce the old source layout.

The inline capture belongs only to an actual attach() on a detached overlay. The owned caller additionally supplies the pre-input value used by existing required-selection handling. A reused OverlayRef receiver initially has no captured value; repeated opening must not recapture. The real FormControl/closing-stream diagnostic rejects both missing first capture and repeated-attach recapture.

Removing the unconditional end-of-attach capture prevents repeated typing/open calls from overwriting the comparison value. The complete before/after prototypes reproduce this defect. Preserve the existing no-options capture fix and require real filtered view/CVA dismissal behavior as a separate native observation.
